description: Entity Framework Core migration class that modifies the schema of the 'Orders' table, specifically the 'ShipToAddress' fields, to enforce non-null constraints and set default values.

classes.name: FixShipToAddress
classes.description: A migration class inheriting from Migration that applies schema changes to the 'Orders' table, ensuring address fields are non-nullable and have default values.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to apply when the migration is executed, altering columns to be non-nullable with default values.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines the operations to revert the schema changes made in Up, restoring columns to nullable state without default values.
